Title: Network switch port flapping in data center rack 7
Description: Observation of port flapping on switch S7-DC-4 in rack 7 causing intermittent link drops for several servers. Logs show STP topology changes and spanning-tree BPDU storms. Traffic disruption noted for virtualization hosts.

Title: Application performance degradation during peak hours
Description: Order processing API shows 2x latency during 14:00-16:00 local time; error rate increases to 1.5%. Service uses microservices architecture with circuit breakers. logs show backpressure on payment service.

Title: Security alert: malware detected on a workstation
Description: Endpoint protection tool detected malware on a Windows 10 workstation in finance. Quarantine actions blocked execution of suspicious process, but user reported system slowdown. Logs show USB device history, unusual process tree, and attempts to connect to known command-and-control servers. User unable to access intranet until malware containment completes. Removed USB device, isolated host, performed root cause analysis, and scanned for persistence mechanisms. Affected: finance workstation, user has limited access.
